mapper.sql: id, code, name, remark, fields_json AS fieldsJson, create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: select from fly_component order by create_time desc
select from fly_component where id = #{id} limit 1
select from fly_component where code = #{code} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into fly_component (id, code, name, remark, fields_json, create_time) values (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{remark}, #{fieldsJson}, now())
